info.title: Pico GTM Brain, log a signal or an event
info.description: Writes to the brain through GitHub's repository_dispatch API. The ingest-event workflow validates the payload against schemas/, appends it to ops/signal-log.md or innovation/events/, refreshes the ledger, and commits. Authenticate with a fine-grained GitHub token for this one repository with Contents read and write.

post.summary: Log what a person said (brain-signal) or what happened (brain-event). Never estimate a value.

type.description: For brain-signal, one of OBJECTION, LANGUAGE, PROOF, STATUS, COMPETITIVE, SEGMENT, CHANNEL, LOSS, RISK. For brain-event, one of activation.step, asset.shipped, case_study.permission, cohort.joined, conversation.first, decision.made, decision.reopened, experiment.closed, experiment.started, install, interview.completed, metric.observed, milestone, partner.signed, payout.made, plan.changed, review.received, session.completed, session.offered, signal.logged, uninstall.

source.description: Where it came from, for example founding call, App Store review, or Partner Dashboard

verbatim.description: brain-signal only: the exact words, never paraphrased

context.description: brain-signal only: who, where, and what was happening

disposition.description: brain-signal only: NOISE (the default), WATCH (n/N), PATCH, or AMEND

tags.description: Tripwire tags, for example handoff-request, theme-issue, gcc-inbound, attribution-dispute

data.description: brain-event only: the facts. A KPI value uses type metric.observed with data {metric, value, period}, for example {"metric": "m.listing_to_install", "value": 0.031}

refs.description: brain-event only: related ids by kind, for example {"experiments": ["EXP-001"], "decisions": ["D33"]}

ts.description: brain-event only: when it happened, ISO 8601 in UTC. Defaults to now

204.description: Accepted. The workflow commits the entry a minute or two later.
